title: BKPM AI-Powered Investment Platform
summary: A production platform for scraping, governing, and serving Indonesian BKPM investment project data through an ML scoring pipeline and React webapp. Its ml_pipeline stage generates semi-synthetic training data by fitting SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on real per-corridor investment data.
evidence: ml_pipeline/scripts/03_generate_semi_synthetic.py:99-99, uses from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and fits it per corridor
